name: Artemether–lumefantrine
gameEffect: After malaria is identified, weakens the Blood Reaver and deals a tactical burst of parasite damage.

name: Paracetamol
gameEffect: Reduces the Fever status penalty. It does not kill the parasite.

name: Oral rehydration solution (ORS)
gameEffect: Restores stamina and reduces the Dehydration status penalty. It does not kill the parasite.
